Zen editor — the bindings, on their own

Grey ⏎ marks a hard break: a line ending in two or more spaces. ctrl+l steps onto the next line there, and to the next block everywhere else.

On form textareas →

Markdown editing

cmd+icursor up
cmd+kcursor down
cmd+jcursor left
cmd+lcursor right
option+jwordwise backward
option+lwordwise forward
ctrl+jsentence start
ctrl+lsentence end
option+icursor up
option+kcursor down

Inside ```clojure

option+jback over a form
option+lover the next form
option+kinto the next list
option+iout of this list, rightwards

The same four keys, in a fenced clojure, clj, cljs, cljc or edn block. Movement stays inside the block; a block of any other language is prose.
